title: Ask the experts: sourcing high-quality datasets for nutritional counselling through Human-AI collaboration

bias_targets.methodology: Expert safety annotation and qualitative analysis of LLM-generated nutrition counseling responses to identify the reinforcement of dietary myths, online misinformation, and dangerous diet culture stereotypes (e.g., inappropriate reward logic).

Qualitative evaluation by nutrition experts of generated texts to identify harmful or stigmatizing behaviors, such as overdiagnosis or providing dangerous suggestions to individuals expressing mental health struggles like depression, anxiety, or eating disorders.
